integrity: All statements are supported by a displayed proof and a reproducible finite numerical cross-check; original exact scalar logistic solutions from arxiv:2002.10372 are acknowledged as prior work. Historical priority remains provisional.
scientific_limitations: Equal-duration two-level deterministic forcing and constant predation rate; only transverse invasion is proved above threshold, and global predator extinction below. No stochastic or spatial result, nonlinear bifurcation classification at equality, or positive attractor assertion. The scalar logistic orbit is established prior art.
title: A sharp seasonal-period extinction threshold for a two-level predator–prey flow
